requirements.summary: Add Web App Manifest with PWA metadata
acceptanceCriteria: manifest.json exists in frontend/public directory
Manifest includes all required PWA fields
Display mode is set to 'standalone' for app-like experience
Icons array includes at least 192x192 and 512x512 sizes

file_operations.description: Create Web App Manifest with name 'Civic Platform', short_name, description, theme_color matching the application's blue-indigo color scheme, background_color, display set to 'standalone', start_url set to '/', and icons array referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/pwa-icon.dim_192x192.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/pwa-icon.dim_512x512.png

requirements.summary: Link Web App Manifest in HTML
acceptanceCriteria: Link tag for manifest is present in the head section of index.html
Manifest link uses correct path to manifest.json

file_operations.description: Add <link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'> tag to the head section to enable PWA functionality

requirements.summary: Create service worker with caching strategies
acceptanceCriteria: Service worker file exists at frontend/public/sw.js
Service worker implements caching for static assets
Service worker handles offline scenarios gracefully
Service worker uses appropriate cache strategies for different resource types

file_operations.description: Create service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets (JS, CSS, images, fonts) and network-first strategy for API calls and canister requests, with install, activate, and fetch event handlers, ensuring compatibility with Internet Computer canister calls

requirements.summary: Register service worker in main application entry
acceptanceCriteria: Service worker registration code is added to main.tsx
Registration includes browser compatibility check
Error handling is implemented for registration failures
Registration occurs after React app initialization

file_operations.description: Add service worker registration after ReactDOM.render() using navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js') with 'serviceWorker' in navigator check for browser support and try-catch error handling for registration failures

requirements.summary: Add theme-color meta tag for browser chrome styling
acceptanceCriteria: Theme-color meta tag is present in index.html head section
Color value matches the application's design system primary color

file_operations.description: Add <meta name='theme-color' content='#4f46e5'> tag to head section matching the application's blue-indigo primary color from the design system

requirements.summary: Wire generated PWA icons into manifest
acceptanceCriteria: Icon files are generated in frontend/public/assets/generated directory
At least two icon sizes are provided: 192x192 and 512x512
Icons have transparent or appropriate backgrounds
Icons are referenced correctly in manifest.json

file_operations.description: Ensure icons array references the generated images at frontend/public/assets/generated/pwa-icon.dim_192x192.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/pwa-icon.dim_512x512.png with correct sizes, type 'image/png', and purpose 'any maskable' for compatibility
